name: 0.24mm Draft Sailfish @MakerBot Replicator 2 0.4 nozzle
description: For printers running Sailfish firmware only. The base profile without "Sailfish" in its name targets the factory firmware, which has no acceleration control and can lose steps above 50 mm/s. Check the firmware before choosing this profile: Sailfish reports version 7.x with variant 0x80.
